Psalm 39:13 uses the same idiom as a plea: 'Look away from me, that I may smile again.' But Amos 5:9 turns the word ominous — God 'flashes destruction upon the stronghold,' the same gleam now wielded as judgment. The Arabic cognate بَلِجَ ('to gleam, be radiant') confirms the root image of sudden brightness."
